questions.category: B2 — Use Shop Tools and Equipment
questions.question: Why should shop equipment be inspected before use?
options: To identify defects, damage, or unsafe conditions
To make equipment run louder
To replace PPE
To avoid using guards
questions.explanation:
Shop equipment can wear or become damaged.
Inspection helps find unsafe conditions before work starts.
Defective equipment should not be used.

questions.category: B3 — Use Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) Equipment
questions.question: Why should GMAW settings match material thickness?
options: Thin and thick metals require different heat input
One setting works for all material
Thickness only affects colour
It replaces joint fit-up
questions.explanation:
Thin metal can burn through with too much heat.
Thicker metal may need more heat for fusion.
Settings must match the material and weld procedure.

questions.category: B4 — Use Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW) Equipment
questions.question: Why is GTAW often used on thin or specialty sheet metal?
options: It provides precise heat control and clean welds
It always requires no shielding gas
It replaces all fitting and clamping
It is only used for cutting
questions.explanation:
GTAW allows controlled heat input.
This helps prevent burn-through and distortion on thin material.
It is also useful for high-quality specialty welds.

questions.category: E2 — Develop Patterns Using Parallel Line Method
questions.question: Why is the parallel line method used for cylindrical shapes?
options: Cylindrical shapes have parallel elements
Cylinders are developed from one apex
It only works for square fittings
It replaces all layout math
questions.explanation:
Parallel line development uses parallel element lines.
It is suited to cylinders and similar shapes.
This method transfers points to a flat pattern.

questions.category: E3 — Develop Patterns Using Radial Line Development
questions.question: When is radial line development commonly used?
options: For tapered shapes such as cones
Only for straight rectangular ducts
Only for flat panels
To replace all pattern development methods
questions.explanation:
Radial line development uses lines from an apex.
It is suitable for cones and tapered fittings.
It creates accurate flat layouts.
